title: Health regen with a cap
prompt: The robot's health recovers at regen points per second but can never go above max_hp. Return the health after one frame. 99 health regenerating 10 per second for 0.5 s is capped at 100.
signature: func solve(hp, regen, max_hp, delta) -> float:
starter:
func solve(hp, regen, max_hp, delta) -> float:
	return hp + regen * delta

tests.name: 50 plus 10 per second for 0.5 s is 55

hints: Add the regen, then cap it.
min() keeps the smaller of two values.

docs.name: min(a, b)
docs.what: Returns the smaller of the two numbers.

solution:
func solve(hp, regen, max_hp, delta) -> float:
	return min(hp + regen * delta, max_hp)
